title: Add RAG Tool-Contract v2 migration guide and micro-quickstart
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: This PR adds a focused migration guide for teams upgrading from Tool-Contract v1 to v2 in RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) workflows, plus a compact micro-quickstart that demonstrates typed tool contracts, safe fallback behavior, and a local sandboxed webhooks emulator. Motivation: a number of customers and internal integrators reported friction when adopting the stric + typed contracts introduced in v2 (ENG-4021). This docset aims to reduce upgrade time by showing concrete migration diffs, recommended validation rules, and a reproducible local example that developers can run in under 5 minutes. What changed: - New doc: docs/rag/tool-contract-v2-migration.md (step-by-step migration, compatibility table, checklist) - New quickstart: examples/rag/tool-contract-v2-micro-quickstart/ (minimal node and python stubs, sandbox webhook emulator, prebuilt example index) - Linter rules: docs/tool-contract-linting.md (additions to the structured-output and tool-call linters) - Contributing notes: docs/rag/authoring-guidelines.md (short note about version pinning and rollout patterns) Checklist: - [x] Migration guide written with examples and compatibility table - [x] Micro-quickstart added with runnable scripts and README - [x] Lint rules documented and integrated into docs CI - [x] Reviewed by runtime and SDK owners - [x] Smoke-tested locally (node and python) How to validate locally: Follow examples/rag/tool-contract-v2-micro-quickstart/README.md. The quickstart bundles: - a minimal typed contract schema (JSON Schema + examples) - a small sandbox that simulates transient tool failures and demonstrates fallback chains - a stepwise migration script that applies automated AST-friendly transforms for common v1->v2 patterns Links: Linear ENG-4021, docs preview at https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/rag/tool-contract-v2-migration (internal preview). Reasoning: By pairing a migration narrative with an executable micro-quickstart and linter recommendations we reduce blast radius for rollouts and help platform teams automate checks in CI.
